findings.justification: aws-cdk-lib 2.262.2 is the latest AWS CDK release and bundles brace-expansion 5.0.7, which remains affected by GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg. npm cannot replace this bundled dependency. The affected minimatch path is used only while synthesizing this fixed-input infrastructure example and is not shipped in its Lambda assets. Keep the advisory visible in SEC-2 evidence and re-review or remove this exception by the expiry date.
